g.title: step_positions
g.text: One step: positions, the job each hands out, the feed each edge waits for
edge label = what causes the move, then the number of scenarios that made it; dashed red = the code allows it, no scenario makes it; orange = only the property tests make it

g.title: Input
g.text: input phase: pre_input hooks, then commit a User node, per pending input

g.title: Tools
g.text: decide whether a batch runs (no job of its own)

g.title: PreReply
g.text: pre_reply hooks on the reply draft, then commit the Assistant node

g.title: Calls
g.text: the tool calls run in the driver; outcomes arrive one by one

g.title: PostResult
g.text: post_result hooks, after the Results node is written

g.title: Throttle
g.text: wait 250 ms before the next step (nothing was committed)
